body.sql: SELECT count() AS value, toStartOfInterval(startTime, INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) AS ts, serviceName FROM otel_spans WHERE startTime IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ts, serviceName ORDER BY ts ASC, serviceName ASC LIMIT 10000;

SELECT count() AS total, countIf(durationInNanos <= 500000000) AS s, countIf(durationInNanos > 500000000 AND durationInNanos <= 2000000000) AS t, serviceName, round((s + t * 0.5) / total, 4) AS apdex FROM otel_spans WHERE kind IN ('SPAN_KIND_SERVER', 'SPAN_KIND_CONSUMER') GROUP BY serviceName ORDER BY apdex ASC LIMIT 10000;

SELECT total, affected, name, all_total, all_affected, round(affected / total, 4) AS rate, round(all_affected / all_total, 4) AS overall_rate FROM (SELECT total, affected, name, sum(total) OVER () AS all_total, sum(affected) OVER () AS all_affected FROM (SELECT count() AS total, countIf(durationInNanos > 100000000) AS affected, name FROM otel_spans WHERE serviceName = 'frontend' AND kind = 'SPAN_KIND_SERVER' GROUP BY name)) WHERE total >= 20 ORDER BY rate DESC LIMIT 20;
SELECT uniqExact(traceId) AS trace_count, serviceName FROM otel_spans GROUP BY serviceName ORDER BY trace_count DESC LIMIT 10000;
SELECT count() AS span_count, traceId FROM otel_spans GROUP BY traceId ORDER BY span_count DESC LIMIT 20;
SELECT count() AS cnt FROM otel_spans WHERE serviceName = 'checkout' AND endTime >= toDateTime64('2026-10-16 06:40:00', 9, 'UTC');
SELECT * FROM otel_spans ORDER BY startTime DESC LIMIT 50;

SELECT count() AS spans_with_exception, toStartOfInterval(startTime, INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) AS t_min, serviceName FROM otel_spans WHERE has(events.name, 'exception') AND startTime IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t_min, serviceName ORDER BY t_min ASC, serviceName ASC LIMIT 10000;
SELECT * FROM otel_logs WHERE traceId = '59c5c193c46bf6d736d615d2a5ca8001' LIMIT 1000;
SELECT count() AS count, toStartOfInterval(eventTime, INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) AS t, severityText FROM otel_logs GROUP BY t, severityText ORDER BY t ASC, severityText ASC LIMIT 10000;

SELECT count() AS value, toStartOfInterval(eventTime, INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) AS t, serviceName FROM otel_logs WHERE upperUTF8(severityText) IN ('ERROR', 'WARN', 'WARNING') GROUP BY t, serviceName ORDER BY t ASC, serviceName ASC LIMIT 10000;
SELECT * FROM otel_logs WHERE time >= toDateTime64('2026-10-15 16:40:00', 9, 'UTC') AND time <= toDateTime64('2026-10-15 21:40:00', 9, 'UTC') AND severityNumber >= 17 ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT eventTime, serviceName, severityText, body FROM otel_logs WHERE hasTokenCaseInsensitive(body, 'order') AND hasTokenCaseInsensitive(body, 'placed') AND serviceName = 'checkout' AND eventTime >= toDateTime64('2026-10-15 21:00:00', 9, 'UTC') AND eventTime < toDateTime64('2026-10-15 21:30:00', 9, 'UTC') ORDER BY eventTime DESC LIMIT 100;
SELECT count() AS c FROM otel_logs WHERE hasTokenCaseInsensitive(body, 'connect') AND hasTokenCaseInsensitive(body, 'redis');

SELECT * FROM otel_logs WHERE hasTokenCaseInsensitive(body, 'GET') AND eventTime >= toDateTime64('2026-10-15 21:00:00', 9, 'UTC') AND eventTime <= toDateTime64('2026-10-16 06:50:00', 9, 'UTC') ORDER BY eventTime DESC LIMIT 100;
SELECT eventTime AS ts, serviceName, severityText, body FROM otel_logs WHERE body ILIKE '%redis%' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT count() AS n, if(body IS NULL OR body = '', '', replaceRegexpAll(body, '[a-zA-Z0-9]+', '<*>')) AS patterns_field FROM otel_logs WHERE serviceName = 'cart' AND body IS NOT NULL AND NOT (body ILIKE '%ValkeyCartStore%') AND NOT (body ILIKE '%called with userId%') GROUP BY patterns_field ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 20;

SELECT count() AS n, avg(d) AS avg_ms, quantileTDigest(0.95)(d) AS p95_ms, max(d) AS max_ms, method, path FROM (SELECT extractGroups(body, '^\\[([^\\]]+)\\] "(\\S+) (\\S+) ([^"]+)" (\\d{3}) (\\S+) (\\S+) (\\S+) "([^"]*)" (\\d+) (\\d+) (\\d+) [\\s\\S]+') AS g, g[2] AS method, g[3] AS path, toInt32OrNull(g[12]) AS d FROM otel_logs WHERE serviceName = 'frontend-proxy') GROUP BY method, path ORDER BY n DESC, method ASC, path ASC LIMIT 20;
SELECT * FROM otel_logs ORDER BY eventTime DESC LIMIT 1000;
SELECT * FROM otel_logs LIMIT 10;
SELECT * FROM otel_logs ORDER BY eventTime DESC LIMIT 10;
SELECT * FROM otel_logs WHERE serviceName = 'product-reviews' ORDER BY eventTime DESC LIMIT 10;
SELECT * FROM otel_logs WHERE serviceName = 'kafka' LIMIT 10;
SELECT * FROM otel_logs WHERE serviceName = 'product-reviews' AND eventTime >= toDateTime64('2026-10-15 23:00:00', 9, 'UTC') AND eventTime < toDateTime64('2026-10-16 00:35:00', 9, 'UTC') LIMIT 10;
SELECT * FROM otel_spans WHERE durationInNanos >= 20000000 AND durationInNanos <= 200000000 LIMIT 10;
SELECT * FROM otel_spans ORDER BY durationInNanos DESC LIMIT 10;
SELECT count() AS `count()`, toStartOfInterval(eventTime, INTERVAL 1 HOUR) AS `span(eventTime,1h)` FROM otel_logs GROUP BY `span(eventTime,1h)` LIMIT 10000;

SELECT count() AS `count()`, multiIf(durationInNanos < 1000000, 'a_lt_1ms', durationInNanos >= 1000000 AND durationInNanos < 10000000, 'b_1_10ms', durationInNanos >= 10000000 AND durationInNanos < 100000000, 'c_10_100ms', durationInNanos >= 100000000 AND durationInNanos < 1000000000, 'd_100ms_1s', durationInNanos >= 1000000000 AND durationInNanos < 10000000000, 'e_1_10s', durationInNanos >= 10000000000, 'f_ge_10s', NULL) AS latency_band FROM otel_spans GROUP BY latency_band LIMIT 10000;

SELECT count() AS `count()`, serviceName, kind FROM otel_spans WHERE eventTime >= toDateTime64('2026-10-16 02:00:00', 9, 'UTC') AND eventTime < toDateTime64('2026-10-16 02:10:00', 9, 'UTC') GROUP BY serviceName, kind ORDER BY `count()` DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT count() AS `count()`, serviceName, kind FROM otel_spans WHERE eventTime >= toDateTime64('2026-10-16 01:00:00', 9, 'UTC') AND eventTime < toDateTime64('2026-10-16 01:20:00', 9, 'UTC') GROUP BY serviceName, kind ORDER BY serviceName DESC, kind ASC LIMIT 10;
SELECT uniqExact(traceId) AS `dc(traceId)` FROM otel_spans;
SELECT * FROM otel_logs WHERE hasTokenCaseInsensitive(body, 'telescope') OR hasTokenCaseInsensitive(body, 'binoculars') OR hasTokenCaseInsensitive(body, 'score') LIMIT 10;
SELECT count() AS points, argMax(value, eventTime) AS last_value, max(eventTime) AS last_seen, name FROM otel_metrics WHERE kind = 'GAUGE' GROUP BY name ORDER BY points DESC LIMIT 10;
SELECT count() AS spans FROM otel_spans;
SELECT count() AS spans, traceId, serviceName FROM otel_spans GROUP BY traceId, serviceName LIMIT 10;
SELECT count() AS c, durationInNanos, durationInNanos - 1 AS d1, durationInNanos - 2 AS d2, durationInNanos - 3 AS d3 FROM otel_spans GROUP BY durationInNanos, d1, d2, d3 ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT count() AS pv, toStartOfInterval(startTime, INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) AS minute, name FROM otel_spans WHERE serviceName = 'cart' AND name IN ('HGET', 'HMSET', 'EXPIRE', 'POST /oteldemo.CartService/GetCart', 'POST /oteldemo.CartService/AddItem', 'POST /oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart') AND startTime IS NOT NULL GROUP BY name, minute ORDER BY pv DESC LIMIT 10 OFFSET 100;
SELECT count() AS c, traceId, toMinute(startTime) AS m, name FROM otel_spans GROUP BY traceId, m, name ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 10;
SELECT avg(value) AS avg_count FROM (SELECT count() AS value FROM otel_spans WHERE serviceName = 'frontend' AND startTime IS NOT NULL GROUP BY toStartOfInterval(startTime, INTERVAL 1 MINUTE));

SELECT count() AS logs, avg(lengthUTF8(body)) AS avg_len, max(lengthUTF8(body)) AS max_len, sum(lengthUTF8(body)) AS bytes, serviceName FROM otel_logs GROUP BY serviceName HAVING logs > 1000 ORDER BY bytes DESC LIMIT 10000;

SELECT count() AS nonempty_bucket_entries, name FROM otel_metrics ARRAY JOIN bucketCountsList AS bucket WHERE kind = 'HISTOGRAM' AND bucket > 0 GROUP BY name ORDER BY nonempty_bucket_entries DESC, name ASC LIMIT 10;

SELECT uniqExact(severityNumber) AS sev_numbers, uniqExact(severityText) AS sev_labels, arraySort(groupUniqArray(severityText)) AS labels, serviceName, arrayStringConcat(labels, ',') AS label_list FROM otel_logs GROUP BY serviceName HAVING sev_labels > 1 ORDER BY sev_labels DESC, serviceName ASC LIMIT 10000;
SELECT count() AS spans, uniqExact(durationInNanos) AS distinct_durations, serviceName FROM otel_spans GROUP BY serviceName ORDER BY spans DESC LIMIT 10000;

SELECT uniqExact(time) AS export_timestamps, count() AS points, min(time) AS first_export, max(time) AS last_export, serviceName FROM otel_metrics GROUP BY serviceName ORDER BY export_timestamps ASC, serviceName ASC LIMIT 10000;

SELECT count() AS spans, uniqCombined(traceId) AS traces, toStartOfInterval(startTime, INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) AS minute FROM otel_spans WHERE startTime IS NOT NULL GROUP BY minute ORDER BY minute ASC LIMIT 10000;
